tasks.label: Android: Build, install, and launch on phone
args: npm run build; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npx cap sync android; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; .\android\gradlew.bat -p android installDebug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; adb shell monkey -p com.vaangly.app 1

tasks.label: Android: Logcat Vaangly
args: $packagePid = (adb shell pidof -s com.vaangly.app).Trim(); if (-not $packagePid) { Write-Error 'Vaangly is not running on the connected phone.'; exit 1 }; adb logcat --pid=$packagePid '*:V'
